hdf.pixel_scale: Detector pixel coordinates only; no object-plane conversion

identity.calibration_status: Detector-scale metadata not used as object-plane calibration; no physical conversion

baseline.sensor_saturation: Unknown without independently verified sensor limits; observed max fraction is not proof of clipping
baseline.snr_definition: (P95 - selected border background)/(1.4826*borderMAD); descriptive detector contrast, not radiometric SNR
baseline.centroid_definition: Positive (raw-background) intensity weights over fixed detector ROI; not a physical plasma position/size reconstruction

profiles.unit: raw detector units summed along orthogonal detector pixels

uncertainty.interpretation: Pixel-grid discretization and parameter sensitivity are not total physical measurement error

robustness.method: All6declared background/fixedROI combinations; range is preprocessing sensitivity, not a confidence interval or physical shot-to-shot difference

limits: Original HDF contains both raw gel detector values and processed PSL data; only gel_raw is analyzed.

No operating parameters, target specifications, implosion performance, yield, shock timing or ignition optimization are analyzed.
Raw versus processed display uses explicit border subtraction/linear quantile scaling; display pixels are not new radiometric measurements.

findings.title: Verified experimental diagnostic inventory
findings.method: Bounded ZIP path/type/size validation, hashes, original HDF4 layout inspection
findings.uncertainty: Inventory counts exact for the acquired archive; calibration completeness not assumed
findings.limits: Only raw detector image arrays analyzed numerically; target/operating/performance and processed nuclear diagnostics excluded.

findings.title: Raw detector-frame intensity and coordinate characterization
findings.method: Original gel_raw arrays, finite pixels, declared border background and positive detector-intensity weights
findings.unit: uncalibrated detector units and detector pixels
findings.uncertainty: Pixel-grid half-pixel descriptor; total calibration/systematic error not available
findings.limits: No physical plasma size, object-plane geometry, temperature, yield or implosion performance reconstructed.

findings.title: Same-measurement preprocessing robustness
findings.method: All6fixed combinations of borderquantile25/50/75 and whole/central80percentROI; no outcome optimization

limitations: Instrument detector values and pixel coordinates only; no conversion to physical plasma dimensions or radiometric quantities.
Processed PSL images, neutron/proton performance diagnostics, target specifications and operating parameters are not analyzed.
Raw gel and source-processed PSL arrays remain distinct; originals remain unchanged.
No absolute yield, temperature, areal density, ignition, implosion model or performance optimization inferred.
ICF03 is methodological robustness of the same measurements, explicitly replacing cross-implosion comparison.
Sensor full scale, calibration errors and systematic uncertainties remain unknown.
